name: single-node-all-benchmarks-scaling
description: Complete single-node study for every enabled benchmark discovered by the runner. The medium thread sweep gives a practical 1..64-thread scaling shape for all workloads, the large 64-thread repeated step is the competitive OpenMP comparison point, and the final 64-thread diagnostic step captures runtime structure for generated-ARTS rows.

steps.name: medium-thread-sweep
steps.description: Run every enabled benchmark on one node across 1,2,4,8,16,32,64 threads. Medium size keeps slow single-thread rows observable without turning the scaling screen into an all-day run.

steps.name: large-64-competitive
steps.description: Run every enabled benchmark at the target single-node point: large size, 64 threads, three paired samples. This is the stable CARTS-vs-OpenMP acceptance step.

steps.name: large-64-runtime-diagnostics
steps.description: Capture thread-level runtime diagnostics at the 64-thread target point. Host OpenMP fallback rows stay isolated; generated ARTS rows expose EDT/runtime structure for follow-up optimization.
